name: Hatten Hotel Melaka
detail: Overall, I am very satisfied with my stay at this hotel. The check-in and check-out process went smoothly with the help of very friendly and professional staff. The cleanliness of the room was at its best, the mattress was very soft, and the room space felt spacious and comfortable. The breakfast menu also offered a variety of delicious local and international dishes. The hotel's location is very strategic as it is close to various amenities and attractions. I will definitely return in the future!

name: Sunday Malacca Formerly Tun Fatimah
detail: senang parking, location yang bagus, nak kemana mana jalan kaki sahaja boleh sampai, sepanjang laluan riverside sangat cantik. bilik bersih, tiada sarapan pagi tapi tidak mengapa kerana harga pun sangat murah. ini kalai kedua menginap disini.. saya akan datang lagi.

name: Sunday Malacca Near Jonker Street Formerly Quayside
detail: I am very satisfied with my 3 days and 2 nights stay at Quayside Hotel Melaka! We took a River View room - the view is really beautiful at night with the lights of the Melaka River, and the kids were excited to see the River Cruise boats passing by. The location is definitely 10/10, right next to the Water Wheel, it’s just a short walk to Jonker Street, Stadthuys & Museum. It’s easy to take little ones out without needing to drive. The room was clean, the bed was comfortable, and the air conditioner was cool. The front desk staff were very friendly and helpful. It’s truly value for money with such a prime location. Perfect for a family trip. Thank you Quayside Hotel, God willing I will visit again! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

name: Dusit Princess Melaka
detail: Location It was close to the Malacca River, walkable, and I really liked the surrounding restaurants. Breakfast Since I visited early in the morning, I was able to try various types during the quiet hours. Service I received RM50 dining tickets for each night of my stay, which I used to buy fresh juice and cookies in the evening, allowing me to use the café without paying extra. When I returned in the evening, the cleaning had not yet been done, but they responded immediately when I inquired. All the staff were friendly. Parking When I informed the front desk of my car number when leaving, I was able to use it for free. Pool Clean bath towels were provided. The pool depth varied from 0.6m to 2.7m, which was enjoyable. One concern There was a smell of cigarettes from somewhere, and I wasn't sure if it was from the neighboring room, but I thought the room was non-smoking, so that was a downside. Despite the very reasonable price, the experience was very fulfilling, so I definitely want to use it again.

name: Asteria Melaka by Attic Suite
detail: This stay experience was simply perfect, I have to give it a full five-star review! 🌟 As soon as I opened the door, a wonderful scent greeted me, and the whole room was brightly lit, which perfectly matched my aesthetic since I love bright rooms! 😍 ❄️ **Well-equipped and considerate:** The air conditioning is super powerful, and the room is fully equipped with everything; you don't need to worry even if you accidentally forget your daily necessities! The TV can even watch YouTube for binge-watching, it's just wonderful～📺 🏊‍♂️ **Bonus for leisure facilities:** The hotel also has a **swimming pool** and a **gym**, whether you want to relax in the water or maintain your workout routine, it's perfect, really amazing! 💪✨ 💄 **Girls love the vanity area:** I must rave about their makeup table and wash area! The mirror has its own lighting and the brightness is adjustable🔆, and the best part is it comes with a chair, allowing makeup-loving girls to sit comfortably and take their time, it's just super nice! 💯 🛏️ **Comfort level at its peak:** The bedding is incredibly comfortable! It's so nice to sleep in that you want to stay in bed all day; this is one of the few hotels that makes me reluctant to check out! 🚗 **Great location:** It's super convenient to go anywhere! There’s a mart and various snack shops right downstairs, no need to worry about buying things or food. Next time in Malacca, I’d definitely choose this hotel with my eyes closed! 💖 Highly recommend it to all friends who are going to Malacca! Just go for it!

name: Bayview Hotel Melaka
detail: The room is very clean, spacious, and equipped with complete facilities such as a TV, air conditioning, and toiletries. The bed is very comfortable, allowing me to rest maximally. The hotel staff service is very friendly and professional. They are always ready to assist with my needs, from check-in to arranging transportation. The breakfast provided is also delicious, with a variety of menu options ranging from local to international dishes. The location is strategic, close to shopping centers and tourist attractions, making it easy for me to explore the surrounding area. Additional facilities such as the swimming pool and gym are also well-maintained and enjoyable to use. Overall, I highly recommend this hotel for anyone looking for a comfortable and memorable stay. I will definitely return on my next visit.

name: Estadia Hotel
detail: Lobi hotel cantik dan selesa. Ada room service, itu yang best. Bilik pun cantik. Sabun wangi. Staf semua baik dan peramah. Breakfast buffet pun sedap. Yang tak bestnya masa breakfast panas berkuap kafenya. Malam pun sebenarnya saya nak dine in tapi sebab panas sangat sampai berpeluh, saya order room service je. Harap pihak hotel boleh repair aircond kafe. Atau sebenarnya tak rosak, just takmau buka? Hotel dah best, tapi memikirkan kafe panas tu agak turned off lah.

name: The Pines by Amanjiwa
detail: It was a hotel with a dungeon-like feel, such as receiving the key away from the hotel entrance. The location didn't have any restaurants or shops nearby, but since taxis are cheap in Malaysia, it wasn't much of a problem. The room was very clean, spacious, and I was able to use the hotel pool (just make sure to bring your own towel), making for a comfortable stay.
area: Malacca City Center,Malacca - View on map

name: JonkeRED Heritage Hotel
detail: Highly recommend this hotel..! The location is excellent. The room isn't very big, but it's very comfortable.. It has everything you need. The bathroom is huge—you could almost turn it into another room! 😁 Most importantly, the hotel is spotlessly clean.. I couldn't find a single speck of dirt.. The staff are incredibly friendly, always smiling, and make you feel very welcome.. Everything about this hotel is just perfect.. I will definitely stay here again on my next visit. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

name: Swiss-Garden Hotel Melaka
detail: It's a bit far from the center of Malacca, but the location is good because it's nice to walk along the river. The breakfast is fine if you're not averse to local food. However, if you're expecting something like a 4-5 star hotel in Vietnam, you might be disappointed. The swimming pool can be seen as separate from the children's pool. The adult pool is quite spacious. The condition of the rooms is similar to other 4-star hotels, and there is plenty of space.
